description: Contract termination advice must include ≥1 pinpoint article, not a pure procedural playbook
query: አንድ ደንበኛዬ ከባንክ ጋር ውል ፈፀመ። ውሉን ለማፍረስ ቢፈልግ በህግ ምን ትመክረዋለህ?
tool_payload:
[Source: english-civil-code-1960 | Article 1675 | Contract defined]
A contract is an agreement whereby two or more persons as between themselves create, vary or extinguish obligations of a proprietary nature.

[Source: english-civil-code-1960 | Article 1771 | Rescission for non-performance]
A party may demand the cancellation of the contract where the other party fails to perform his obligations and where notice to perform has been ineffective.
